fields.statement: QA with rhiza built from 3d2eb196f to a scratch path, in a throwaway repo, capped scope, RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset. Happy: workflow describe ship-change lists 12 steps conduct..deploy-check; merge on.fail->rebase, on.pass->main-ci; rebase on.fail->handback:conduct, on.pass->wait-ci; pr-green fail->handback:conduct; main-ci/close-out/ship/deploy-check no on.fail. workflow new --from ship-change copy shows wait-ci until 'rhiza ship check --settled' (no --no-rebase), merge run 'rhiza ship merge', rebase run 'rhiza ship rebase' stall 70m, max_visits 6 on wait-ci/pr-green/merge/rebase, handback_cap 3, conduct prompt without --no-push. In this repo ship-rhiza and bugfix describe/check valid with the same 12 included steps. describe --json repeated is byte-identical and equals api call workflow.describe. Failure: fork with [step.rebase] removed -> workflow check exit 1 'step merge: on.fail names "rebase", which is not a step'; workflow new onto an existing name refused exit 3; ship rebase with no change set exit 2 with next hint.

QA with the scratch build: guide conduct-handback has routes for pr-green and rebase, says the merge step never hands back and never to run rhiza ship rebase, no --no-push; guide conduct-roles gives conflict-fix for a conflict the ship steps leave in progress (CI wait, rebase step); guide workflows lists the 12 steps with pr-green and rebase. workflow check docs/examples/byo/conductor.toml valid (only the uninstalled /myteam:conduct warning); its steps from gate on are identical (comments stripped) to workflow new --from ship-change; pair workflow new --from <byo path> then workflow check valid. Failure: byo copy with handback:nope -> exit 1 naming gate, push, pr-green, rebase; guide with a typo name exit 4. Greps: no --no-rebase in the byo docs, no 'ten steps' in runs-and-daemon.md (12-step entry, failed merge goes to rebase), no 'ship rebase --no-push' in conduct-roles.md, pr-green in primitives.md.

QA: go test -p 2 -trimpath -count=1 -v ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-change-one-ci|guide|workflow-new)$' (capped scope, env cleaned) PASS, ship-change-one-ci 4.99s: happy path one CI wait/merge, main-moved case merge(visit 1) fail then rebase pass then wait-ci/pr-green/merge visit 2 with conduct visited once and no handback; conflict case rebase fail then conduct (visit 2), gate, signoff, push, merge visit 2.
